ticker.name: KUSURI NO AOKI HOLDINGS CO LTD

business_summary: Kusuri No Aoki Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the retail sale of pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and daily good products in Japan. The company offers medicines; health foods such, as vitamin supplements and dietary supplements; first aid supplies; health management and medical supplies; beauty counseling cosmetics; and facial care products, including face washes; andbody care products, such as body soaps. It also provides shampoos; toothpaste; diapers and other baby-related products, nursing care products, sanitary products, detergents, household goods, pet food, socks and underwear, clothing, and home appliances; and processed foods, daily foods, fresh foods, seasonings, sweets, drinks, and alcohol products. In addition, the company operates prescription dispensing pharmacies and drug store. Kusuri No Aoki Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1869 and is based in Hakusan, Japan.
